edit.description: Narrow deleteBranch's catch to the 'not found' case only; rethrow other git errors per Loud or nothing.
Wrap the teardown loop's deleteBranch call (~L1806) in try/catch; log.warn naming the branch on rethrow, mirroring the loop's existing removeWorktree/teardownWorktree warn pattern.
Cover deleteBranch: silent on not-found, rejects when the branch is checked out in a worktree.
Cover the teardown loop warning on a real deleteBranch failure (spy git.deleteBranch, assert log.warn names the branch).

summary: deleteBranch swallows every git branch -D failure, not just 'not found' — narrow the catch and surface real failures per Loud or nothing.

tests.asserts: deleteBranch resolves silently when the branch doesn't exist; rejects when the branch is checked out in a worktree.
teardown loop logs a warning naming the branch when deleteBranch rejects for a non-benign reason.

acceptance: deleteBranch only swallows the 'not found' case; a real deletion failure (e.g. branch still checked out after a survived worktree) propagates to the teardown loop and is logged, not lost.
notes: Same shape as BACKLOG-GROOMER-ENOENT-ONLY-SWALLOW (bd51677/8d63aa8): a catch-all narrowed to the one expected-benign case. Found sweeping tests/git.test.ts neighborhood (src/git.ts); no test existed for deleteBranch at all.
